name: Introduction to Human Geography, 2nd ed. (Dorrell, Henderson, Lindley and Connor)
goodFor: An introductory human geography textbook (population, migration, culture, language, religion, political geography, development, cities) with exercises, sample questions and lecture slides.

notes: The Affordable Learning Georgia repository's record for the 2nd edition (2019; David Dorrell, Joseph Henderson, Todd Lindley and Georgeta Connor of Georgia Gwinnett College; a partner text with the University of North Georgia Press) states CC BY 4.0, which would allow commercial use. Kept at link because the book itself wasn't read: its PDF on oer.galileo.usg.edu returned a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' page instead of the file, and the copy the UNG Press page offers is on web.ung.edu, which isn't reachable. The UNG Press page states no licence and sells a print edition, and the repository says most, not all, of its works carry a Creative Commons licence. Whether the book has an 'except where otherwise noted' clause or third-party maps and photos under other terms (the press calls it richly illustrated) is unknown. The repository's footer Copyright link points to Elsevier's website terms (Digital Commons), which weren't read. To move it to entries, read the licence on the book's own copyright page and check how its figures are credited.
